digest.component_or_area: doctor diagnostic command / mapping configuration validation
propositions: offline mapping config diagnostics must detect and report load-time errors (non-integer hierarchy, malformed blocks) and resolve-time errors (out-of-vocabulary, unmapped-non-skipped values) as error findings with non-zero exit

live-drift check against Jira status/type/link vocabulary must run only when jira-datacenter extra is installed and credentials resolve, degrading to a single unavailable finding when preconditions fail or transport times out

rebar doctor must remain portable and run without jira-datacenter extra or credentials set, always executing offline checks and cleanly handling unavailable live-drift checks without raising exceptions
doctor mapping diagnostics must enumerate config.projects union default layer and validate each key through provider-neutral resolvers without importing adapters.jira in offline paths
all-empty projects config blocks must surface as warnings (not errors) to distinguish stubs from genuine validation failures
live-drift findings must be rendered in a separate list (mirroring scan-dirty/lock reports) and kept out of run_repair iteration to preserve doctor.scan blocking-edge contract
